items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] In fact, Smiley worked there before I did at Lutches.

ctx.x: You know, you had a job at Lutches? Yeah, see I had a job already at Lutches.

In fact, Smiley worked there before I did at Lutches. Years back, years ahead of me. I remember him being there too one time. See, after that, what's this boy, Melvin Frank, I don't know if he's still living?
Wait, let me tell you now how everything happened.
